L16: ## 52.27 Invertible modules on punctured spectra, II
L17: 
L18: Next we turn to surjectivity in local Lefschetz for the Picard group. First to extend an invertible module on $U_0$ to an open neighbourhood we have the following simple criterion.
L19: 
L20: 【11†Lemma 52.27.1.】 Let $(A, \mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring and $f \in \mathfrak m$. Assume
L21: 
L22:   1. $A$ is $f$-adically complete,
L23: 
L24:   2. $f$ is a nonzerodivisor,
L25: 
L26:   3. $H^1_\mathfrak m(A/fA)$ and $H^2_\mathfrak m(A/fA)$ are finite $A$-modules, and
L27:   4. $H^3_\mathfrak m(A/fA) = 0$【12†^{1}】.
L28: 
L29: Let $U$, resp. $U_0$ be the punctured spectrum of $A$, resp. $A/fA$. Then
L30: 
L31: \[ \mathop{\mathrm{colim}}\nolimits _{U_0 \subset U' \subset U\text{ open}} \mathop{\mathrm{Pic}}\nolimits (U') \longrightarrow \mathop{\mathrm{Pic}}\nolimits (U_0) \]
L32: 
L33: is surjective.
